name: AWS CloudTrail - PCI Req 01 - Access Monitoring - New
title: AWS CloudTrail - PCI Req 01 - Access Monitoring - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* *SecurityGroup*
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name nodrop
| where event_name matches "*SecurityGroup*" and !(event_name matches "Describe*")  and !(event_name matches "Get*") and !(event_name matches "List*")
| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{event_name}}" = "*", true, event_name matches "{{event_name}}")
|count as eventCount by _timeslice, event_name
| transpose row _timeslice column event_name

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* *SecurityGroup*
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as event_source nodrop | parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name nodrop | parse "\"eventType\":\"*\"" as event_Type nodrop | parse "\"awsRegion\":\"*\"" as aws_Region nodrop | parse "\"sourceIPAddress\":\"*\"" as source_ipaddress nodrop | parse "\"principalId\":\"*\"" as principalId nodrop | parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user nodrop | parse "\"roleName\":\"*\"" as roleName nodrop | parse "\"accountId\":\"*\"" as accountId nodrop | parse "\"arn\":\"*\"" as arn nodrop | parse "\"portRange\":{\"from\":*,\"to\":*}" as from_port,to_port nodrop | parse "\"fromPort\":*,\"toPort\":*," as from_Port,to_Port nodrop | parse "\"cidrBlock\":\"*\"" as cidr_block nodrop | parse "\"cidrIp\":\"*\"" as cidr_ip nodrop | parse "\"egress\":*," as egress nodrop  | parse "\"ruleAction\":\"*\"" as action nodrop | parse "\"groupName\":\"*\"," as groupName nodrop | parse "\"groupDescription\":\"*\"," as groupDescription nodrop | parse "\"groupId\":\"*\"" as groupId nodrop | parse regex field=event_name "SecurityGroup(?<direction>[A-Za-z]+)" nodrop | parse field=principalId "*:*" as accesskeyId, user_temp nodrop | parse field=arn "*:*:*::*:*" as f1, f2, f3, f4, user nodrop | parse field=arn "*:*:*::*:*/*/*" as f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, role, f7 nodrop
| where event_name matches "*SecurityGroup*" and !(event_name matches "Describe*")
| if (isEmpty(user) and !isEmpty(user_temp), user_temp, user) as user
| source_ipaddress as src_ip | user as src_user
| timeslice 1s
|where if ("{{accountid}}" = "*", true, accountid matches "{{accountid}}") AND if ("{{role}}" = "*", true, role matches "{{role}}") AND if ("{{source_ipaddress}}" = "*", true, source_ipaddress matches "{{source_ipaddress}}") AND if ("{{rolename}}" = "*", true, rolename matches "{{rolename}}") AND if ("{{user}}" = "*", true, user matches "{{user}}") AND if ("{{aws_region}}" = "*", true, aws_region matches "{{aws_region}}") AND if ("{{event_type}}" = "*", true, event_type matches "{{event_type}}") AND if ("{{event_name}}" = "*", true, event_name matches "{{event_name}}") AND if ("{{principalid}}" = "*", true, principalid matches "{{principalid}}")
|count as eventCount by _timeslice, src_ip, src_user, event_type, event_name, event_source, principalid, aws_region, groupid, groupname, groupDescription, direction, from_port, to_Port, cidr_block, cidr_ip, egress, action, accountid
| sort by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail*
